sequences.name: Flat Barbell Bench Press
sequences.variant: Flat barbell bench, bilateral, flat bench/rack

frames.camera: Side three-quarter; whole body, bench, rack and bar visible
frames.captionDraft: Plant your feet and steady the bar.
frames.reviewCheck: Reviewer verifies stable body contact, grip, rack safety and the photographed bar position. Unrack/rerack may need extra frames.

frames.camera: Same camera, subject, grip, equipment and scale
frames.reviewCheck: Reviewer defines and verifies the appropriate lower position and elbow/wrist alignment. Do not force a generic depth.

frames.camera: Same locked camera and full-body framing
frames.captionDraft: Press back up while staying braced.
frames.reviewCheck: Reviewer checks completion and body position; add setup/rerack views if three frames do not teach the movement clearly.

sequences.name: Supported Hip CAR
sequences.variant: Standing supported right-hip CAR, one forward circle; exact range/angles pending review

frames.camera: Front three-quarter; full torso, pelvis, support and both feet
frames.reviewCheck: Proposed variant: standing, supported, right hip; stable support stays in the same place in every frame.
Capture hip flexion without substituting trunk rounding. Reviewer sets knee angle/range.

frames.captionDraft: Guide your knee out to the side.
frames.reviewCheck: Show an intermediate transition, not a change of exercise or a 90/90 floor switch.

frames.camera: Same camera; add synchronized second angle only if necessary
frames.reviewCheck: Capture the knee outward while the trunk and support remain consistent; reviewer determines the endpoint.

frames.camera: Secondary rear three-quarter view if needed; clearly identify angle change
frames.captionDraft: Rotate at your hip; keep your body still.
frames.reviewCheck: Show the internal-rotation transition and foot/knee relationship without implying that the knee joint performs the rotation.

frames.camera: Rear/side three-quarter showing hip and trunk together
frames.captionDraft: Move your bent leg behind you.
frames.reviewCheck: Reviewer checks that the pictured motion comes from the hip rather than back arching or pelvic twisting.

frames.camera: Maintain the reviewed view; include stance foot and pelvis
frames.reviewCheck: Capture the transition under the hip, not a jump between disconnected poses.

frames.camera: Return to the original front three-quarter view
frames.reviewCheck: Completes one forward circle only. A reverse-direction demonstration requires separately reviewed ordering/captions and extra frames as needed.
